title: Saltglass Cavern: The Machinist's Resonance Tablet
premise: In a crystalline underworld cut by migratory subterranean rivers, the machinist must rebalance a failing mechanical relay using a portable phase regulator.
ending: Recover the Resonance Tablet and return with the stable field relay; Cavern Chorus can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive shard bloom while evading the mineral sentinel without sacrificing the stable field relay.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Cavern Chorus to witness the portable phase regulator.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to divert power from a shelter
